purpose: DOCUMENTATION ONLY — currency already has a real, verified provider (Frankfurter, via MasterDataRefreshUseCase.refreshCurrencies()) and is not wired to the AI-acquisition endpoint. This definition exists so every master type Integration currently supports has a recorded prompt shape, per the task's own requirement, not because AI should originate currency data.
scope: Not used to call any AI provider today. Exchange rates change continuously and must always come from Frankfurter, never an AI estimate.

fieldFormats.evidence: One sentence — never treated as independent verification; ISO 4217 membership is the only real check, and Frankfurter's own live rate is the only acceptable rate source.

evidenceRequirements: State in one sentence why this ISO code is real. A code is only marked verified here because it matches the ISO 4217 format rule, checked deterministically in Java — never because the model asserted it, and never for the exchange rate itself, which must always come from Frankfurter.
